dialogues.speaker: Tribal Announcement
dialogues.text: "O guests from afar who have scaled mountains on your way, the Scions of the Canopy extend their greetings to you."

dialogues.speaker: Tribal Announcement
dialogues.text: "This is the Bulletin Board for our tribe's affairs. May here you find the information you seek, as well as a path to the attainment of your hopes."

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Continue Reading

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Leave

dialogues.speaker: Tribal Announcement
dialogues.text: "The new Pilgrimage of the Return of the Sacred Flame is about to begin! Scions of the Canopy, make some noise for the contestants representing our tribe!"

dialogues.speaker: Tribal Announcement
dialogues.text: "Give it up for the 'Azure Darts,' our very own veteran couriers Adama and Zeila, as well as the renowned 'Peakwind Hunter,' aka the inimitable Mixquic... Familiar faces that never let us down!"

dialogues.speaker: Tribal Announcement
dialogues.text: "Mr. Kibangu, the 'Cliffside Crusader' himself, who has consistently achieved outstanding results, has boldly declared his intent to secure a spot in the Night Warden Wars!"

dialogues.speaker: Tribal Announcement
dialogues.text: "And let's not forget our extraordinarily talented Saurian Hunter duo, Kinich and Ajaw!"

dialogues.speaker: Tribal Announcement
dialogues.text: "As always, while the competition's on, all courier work will be scheduled in advance and shifts specially assigned to ensure that everyone can attend the matches..."

dialogues.speaker: Tribal Announcement
dialogues.text: "Given the special nature of extreme sports, the Scions of the Canopy only offer these activities to visitors under specific conditions. Please refer to the rules for each activity—"

dialogues.speaker: Tribal Announcement
dialogues.text: "Free Solo Climbing: Due to the specific lighting conditions over at the small cliff, this activity is only available from 10:00 to 18:00 daily."

dialogues.speaker: Tribal Announcement
dialogues.text: "Mountain Parkour: Opening hours vary, depending on when the safety officers complete their course inspection, but are usually between 11:00 and 19:00."

dialogues.speaker: Tribal Announcement
dialogues.text: "Well you wouldn't want to come crashing down because you'd slipped on a Quenepa Berry or something like that, would you?"

dialogues.speaker: Tribal Announcement
dialogues.text: "Hot Air Balloon Racing: Open daily from 07:00 to 20:00, weather permitting and within the safe temperature range."

dialogues.speaker: Tribal Announcement
dialogues.text: "Cliff Bungee Jumping: Hours vary depending on the time it takes to set up the ropes, protective gear, and get the Yumkasaur safety team in place. Please await notification from the supervisor, Pacha."

dialogues.speaker: Tribal Announcement
dialogues.text: "Rescuing participants who have slipped can be an extremely demanding task, so the Yumkasaur safety team will occasionally need a lie-in. Thank you for your understanding..."

dialogues.speaker: Tribal Announcement
dialogues.text: "The majority of our tribe's buildings are suspended on the cliffsides. We kindly ask all visitors to stay safe and avoid getting too close to the platform edges."

dialogues.speaker: Tribal Announcement
dialogues.text: "Until you have undergone the proper training and passed all the basic tests, we advise against casually attempting extreme sports like the Scions of the Canopy."

dialogues.speaker: Tribal Announcement
dialogues.text: "Even though you'd likely be rescued by one of our valiant Yumkasaurs, and thus avoid coming to any real harm, the impact and dizziness of coming to a sudden stop after a free-fall can still be somewhat overwhelming..."

dialogues.speaker: Tribal Announcement
dialogues.text: "You might be left with your legs shaking, traumatized for weeks... So even though you came up the mountain on foot, you'll find yourself crawling back down on your knees."

dialogues.speaker: Tribal Announcement
dialogues.text: "A new batch of courier relay outposts is currently under construction. We're on the lookout for seasoned adventurers with plenty of experience in camping and wilderness survival!"

dialogues.speaker: Tribal Announcement
dialogues.text: "Additionally, utilizing the latest wood treatment techniques from the Collective of Plenty, we've designed a brand-new type of supply station."

dialogues.speaker: Tribal Announcement
dialogues.text: "To assess how well the tribe's Yumkasaurs adapt to these new buildings, we may be moving them around more frequently in the near future, as well as possibly enlisting the help of a few new Saurian friends."

dialogues.speaker: Tribal Announcement
dialogues.text: "Please rest assured, there is no need for any concern or worry!"

dialogues.speaker: Adventurers' Guild Ad
dialogues.text: "...The hour to transcend your limits has come! The Natlan branch of the Adventurers' Guild is now recruiting new members!"

dialogues.speaker: Adventurers' Guild Ad
dialogues.text: "Scions of the Canopy, you who possess the courage to navigate the high peaks and towering cliff faces, extreme sports prodigies of outstanding agility — the Adventurers' Guild needs you!"

dialogues.speaker: Adventurers' Guild Ad
dialogues.text: "Sign up during the event to receive instant access to expert courses and detailed notes compiled by renowned adventurers, three sets of high-quality Guild-standard attire, and we'll even throw in a rookie adventurers' starter kit too!"

dialogues.speaker: Adventurers' Guild Ad
dialogues.text: "For more details, please visit our branch headquarters over at the Stadium of the Sacred Flame and speak with Branch Master Mansa..."

dialogues.speaker: "Small Cliff" Food Ad
dialogues.text: "Today's fast-food menu for the Small Cliff climbing station has been updated—"

dialogues.speaker: "Small Cliff" Food Ad
dialogues.text: "Our all-new Forest of Color paper meal box is light, portable, and spill-resistant, making it the perfect choice for a satisfying meal during your extreme sports adventures!"

dialogues.speaker: "Small Cliff" Food Ad
dialogues.text: "Additionally, the Quenepa Berry Freeze, an all-time favorite of the Yumkasaurs, is back with a vengeance!"

dialogues.speaker: "Small Cliff" Food Ad
dialogues.text: "This time, we've made the sugar coating tougher to prevent it from being crushed before it even reaches the Yumkasaurs' mouths, keeping your hands from getting all sticky! Just please, make sure your kids don't get their hands on them — for Saurians only!"

dialogues.speaker: "Small Cliff" Food Ad
dialogues.text: "Kids that accidentally eat them might have trouble sleeping at night, and could experience other strange side-effects such as wishing they had Saurian tails!"

dialogues.speaker: Anonymous Message
dialogues.text: "Children of Huitztlan, hear my voice."

dialogues.speaker: Anonymous Message
dialogues.text: "The skies darken and the tainted currents flow ever closer."

dialogues.speaker: Anonymous Message
dialogues.text: "The path of the Turnfire is long and winding. How exacting is the price of rushing into danger?"

dialogues.speaker: Anonymous Message
dialogues.text: "But the value of friendship is such that a hero would risk all to retrieve their friends..."

dialogues.speaker: Tribal Announcement
dialogues.text: "Brothers, sisters, Scions of the Canopy. By now, word has surely reached you all: victory is ours!"

dialogues.speaker: Tribal Announcement
dialogues.text: "Let us come together to celebrate this triumph and commemorate the sacrifice of those heroes who gave their lives. And remember, there's no need to go rushing off to the next adventure! We could all do with a good rest."
